summary: Iteration 3 retest: HypeBar render bug on ProductDetail.jsx is FIXED. /product/lung-punch-vinyl now renders both data-testid='hype-bar-detail-lung-punch-vinyl' and data-testid='countdown-detail-lung-punch-vinyl' with all required UI: '387 OF 1,000 SOLD' headline, full 4-unit countdown (DAYS/HOURS/MIN/SEC), green progress bar, '39% CLAIMED' footer, and 'NUMBERED & SIGNED' tag. /product/beatsbydez-hoodie and /product/dez-signal-chain also correctly render their detail hype bars. /product/dez-snapback (non-limited) correctly does NOT render hype-bar-detail. Add-to-cart smoke from Lung Punch detail page works: cart sheet opens automatically with 'Added to your bag' toast, Lung Punch item visible in cart with $45.00 and qty=1. Console clean — only React DevTools info message. One remaining gap: /product/dez-tapes-vinyl does NOT render hype-bar-detail because its seed data has is_limited=True but no total_supply/sold_count/drop_ends_at (HypeBar early-returns + JSX guard `product.is_limited && product.total_supply` correctly hides it). This is a seed-data inconsistency already flagged in iteration_2 code review, not a render regression.
action_items: (Optional / from iter2 code review) Populate total_supply, sold_count, drop_ends_at for dez-tapes-vinyl in backend seed OR drop its is_limited=True flag — currently inconsistent: card has the 'LIMITED' badge but no HypeBar renders (card or detail). Low priority; does not affect Lung Punch flagship drop.
critical_code_review_comments:
Fix applied correctly: `{product.is_limited && product.total_supply && (
)}` at ProductDetail.jsx:75-79. Placement between price and description is good visual hierarchy.

Double-guarding (is_limited + total_supply in parent AND inside HypeBar) is defensive but slightly redundant — could be simplified to just `product.total_supply` since HypeBar already early-returns. Not a bug.

Outstanding from iter2 (still applies): backend reseeds products on every startup, so drop_ends_at countdown effectively resets on each backend restart — acceptable for MVP demo, but production should persist drop_ends_at to DB once and not overwrite.
